title: Parameter-optimal unitary synthesis with flag decompositions
summary: We introduce the flag decomposition as a central tool for unitary synthesis. It lets us carve out a diagonal unitary with $2^n$ degrees of freedom in such a way that the remaining flag circuit is parametrized by the optimal number of $4^n-2^n$ rotations. This enables us to produce parameter-optimal quantum circuits for generic unitaries and matrix product state preparation.
